title: 牛呀牛讓一讓
subject: a Lantau cattle volunteer at eight on a weekday morning on South Lantau Road, coaxing a dozen feral cattle off the white line with a flag and a whistle while three buses, a lorry and a taxi wait; the lead cow Ah Fa chews slowly at her before moving, a new calf hesitates beside its mother, and the first bus driver leans out to promise her a bun tomorrow
caption: Cantonese-language jump swing, lindy-hop dance-band style. A walking upright bass, swing drums riding the ride cymbal with snare kicks and a backbeat on the hi-hat, a stride piano comping and taking short fills, a tight horn section of trumpet, trombone and tenor saxophone playing riffing shout choruses, and a muted trumpet answering the vocal. Punchy live dance-hall swing mix with the horns upfront, roomy but tight. Female Cantonese lead with a bright, brassy alto and crisp rhythmic phrasing, the band shouting the hook back. 172 BPM, B-flat major. Brassy, bustling, cheeky and kind. No electro-swing beats, no programmed drums, no rock guitar, no pop production, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
朝早八點 嶼南道 長沙出梅窩嗰段
十幾隻黃牛 企喺馬路中間唔郁
後面三架巴士 一架貨車 一架的士
我揸住支旗 吹住個銀雞跑出嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
我叫佢哋大姐 我叫佢哋大佬
唔該行入啲 人哋要返工

[Chorus]
牛呀牛 讓一讓 讓一讓
吹一吹銀雞 搖一搖支旗
巴士司機揮揮手 等埋你
牛呀牛 讓一讓 今朝要返工

[Verse]
帶頭嗰隻 我哋叫佢阿花
佢肯郁 成隊都會跟住佢行
但係佢今朝 專登望住我 慢慢嚼草
嚼完一啖 又企返喺白線上面

[Pre-Chorus]
我摸摸佢條頸 同佢講聲早晨
佢擰一擰頭 終於行咗一步

[Chorus]
牛呀牛 讓一讓 行多一步
吹一吹銀雞 搖一搖支旗
巴士司機響一響號 笑住等
牛呀牛 讓一讓 阿花帶路

[Verse]
最後一隻 係今年先出世嘅牛仔
企喺路邊 唔肯離開佢阿媽
阿媽行落草地 佢先跳兩跳跟住
三架巴士 一架一架 慢慢開走

[Bridge]
第一架嗰個司機 開窗叫我一聲
問我聽日幾點 我話八點
佢話好 聽日帶個菠蘿包畀你

[Chorus]
牛呀牛 讓一讓 聽日見
吹一吹銀雞 收埋支旗
成條嶼南道 終於郁得
牛呀牛 讓一讓 聽日八點見

[Outro]
牛呀牛 讓一讓
